shortDescription: Manage IO limit rules on Dell PowerStore

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: burst_percentage
options.description: Burst allowance percentage above the limit. Valid range is 0 to 100.

options.name: io_limit_rule_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the IO limit rule. Specify either I(io_limit_rule_name) or I(io_limit_rule_id) for get/modify/delete operations.

options.name: io_limit_rule_name
options.description: The name of the IO limit rule. Specify either I(io_limit_rule_name) or I(io_limit_rule_id) for get/modify/delete operations.

options.name: limit_type
options.description: Determines how max_iops and max_bw are applied. C(absolute) means limits are absolute values. C(density) means limits are per-GB of volume size.

options.name: max_bw
options.description: Maximum bandwidth limit. Unit depends on I(max_bw_unit) parameter. For Absolute type, API minimum is 2000 KB/s.

options.name: max_bw_unit
options.description: Unit for the I(max_bw) value. Converted to KB/s for the API call.

options.name: max_iops
options.description: Maximum IO operations per second limit. Minimum value is 1, maximum is 2147483646.

options.name: new_name
options.description: New name for the IO limit rule.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the IO limit rule should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
